mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_v2_labor_management ( staff_id, labor_status, time, staff_name_kanji, base_salary, position_allowance, overtime_allowance, other_allowances, advance_payment, commuting_expense, taxable_payment_total, health_insurance_fee, nursing_insurance_fee, welfare_pension_insurance, employment_insurance_fee, other_labor_expenses, total_labor_expenses, comment ) VALUES ( #{staffId}, #{laborStatus}, #{time}, #{staffNameKanji}, #{baseSalary}, #{positionAllowance}, #{overtimeAllowance}, #{otherAllowances}, #{advancePayment}, #{commutingExpense}, #{taxablePaymentTotal}, #{healthInsuranceFee}, #{nursingInsuranceFee}, #{welfarePensionInsurance}, #{employmentInsuranceFee}, #{otherLaborExpenses}, #{totalLaborExpenses}, #{comment} )
mapper.select: SELECT s.staff_id AS staffId, s.staff_name_kanji AS staffNameKanji, DATE_FORMAT(s.operation_end_date, '%Y-%m') AS operationEndMonth, DATE_FORMAT(s.operation_start_date, '%Y-%m') AS operationStartMonth FROM basic_v2_company_staff s JOIN basic_v2_company_management c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE s.active_flg IN (0, 1) AND c.company_abbreviation = 'UCL'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO basic_v2_labor_management (staff_id, staff_name_kanji, time, labor_status,id,base_salary,position_allowance,overtime_allowance,other_allowances,advance_payment,commuting_expense,taxable_payment_total,health_insurance_fee,nursing_insurance_fee,welfare_pension_insurance,employment_insurance_fee,other_labor_expenses,total_labor_expenses) VALUES
(#{item.staffId}, #{item.staffNameKanji}, #{item.time},#{item.laborStatus},#{item.id},#{item.baseSalary},#{item.positionAllowance},#{item.overtimeAllowance},#{item.otherAllowances},#{item.advancePayment},#{item.commutingExpense},#{item.taxablePaymentTotal},#{item.healthInsuranceFee},#{item.nursingInsuranceFee},#{item.welfarePensionInsurance},#{item.employmentInsuranceFee},#{item.otherLaborExpenses},#{item.totalLaborExpenses})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM basic_v2_labor_management lm WHERE time = #{time}

SELECT s.staff_id AS staffId, s.staff_name_kanji AS staffNameKanji FROM basic_v2_company_staff s JOIN basic_v2_company_management c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE s.active_flg IN (0, 1) AND c.company_abbreviation = 'UCL';

SELECT basic_v2_labor_management.id AS id, basic_v2_labor_management.staff_id AS staffId, basic_v2_labor_management.labor_status AS laborStatus, basic_v2_labor_management.time AS time, basic_v2_labor_management.staff_name_kanji AS staffNameKanji, -- 从 basic_v2_labor_management 表获取员工名 basic_v2_labor_management.base_salary AS baseSalary, basic_v2_labor_management.position_allowance AS positionAllowance, basic_v2_labor_management.overtime_allowance AS overtimeAllowance, basic_v2_labor_management.other_allowances AS otherAllowances, basic_v2_labor_management.advance_payment AS advancePayment, basic_v2_labor_management.commuting_expense AS commutingExpense, basic_v2_labor_management.taxable_payment_total AS taxablePaymentTotal, basic_v2_labor_management.health_insurance_fee AS healthInsuranceFee, basic_v2_labor_management.nursing_insurance_fee AS nursingInsuranceFee, basic_v2_labor_management.welfare_pension_insurance AS welfarePensionInsurance, basic_v2_labor_management.employment_insurance_fee AS employmentInsuranceFee, basic_v2_labor_management.other_labor_expenses AS otherLaborExpenses, basic_v2_labor_management.total_labor_expenses AS totalLaborExpenses, basic_v2_labor_management.comment AS comment FROM basic_v2_labor_management WHERE basic_v2_labor_management.id = #{id}

SELECT id AS id, staff_id AS staffId, labor_status AS laborStatus, time AS time, staff_name_kanji AS staffNameKanji, base_salary AS baseSalary, position_allowance AS positionAllowance, overtime_allowance AS overtimeAllowance, other_allowances AS otherAllowances, advance_payment AS advancePayment, commuting_expense AS commutingExpense, taxable_payment_total AS taxablePaymentTotal, health_insurance_fee AS healthInsuranceFee, nursing_insurance_fee AS nursingInsuranceFee, welfare_pension_insurance AS welfarePensionInsurance, employment_insurance_fee AS employmentInsuranceFee, other_labor_expenses AS otherLaborExpenses, total_labor_expenses AS totalLaborExpenses, comment AS comment FROM basic_v2_labor_management WHERE staff_id = #{id} AND time = #{time}
mapper.update: UPDATE basic_v2_labor_management SET labor_status = #{laborStatus}, base_salary = #{baseSalary}, position_allowance = #{positionAllowance}, overtime_allowance = #{overtimeAllowance}, other_allowances = #{otherAllowances}, advance_payment = #{advancePayment}, commuting_expense = #{commutingExpense}, taxable_payment_total = #{taxablePaymentTotal}, health_insurance_fee = #{healthInsuranceFee}, nursing_insurance_fee = #{nursingInsuranceFee}, welfare_pension_insurance = #{welfarePensionInsurance}, employment_insurance_fee = #{employmentInsuranceFee}, other_labor_expenses = #{otherLaborExpenses}, total_labor_expenses = #{totalLaborExpenses}, comment = #{comment} WHERE id = #{id} AND time = #{time}

update.foreach: UPDATE basic_v2_labor_management SET labor_status = #{item.laborStatus}, base_salary = #{item.baseSalary}, position_allowance = #{item.positionAllowance}, other_allowances = #{item.otherAllowances}, commuting_expense = #{item.commutingExpense}, taxable_payment_total = #{item.taxablePaymentTotal}, health_insurance_fee = #{item.healthInsuranceFee}, nursing_insurance_fee = #{item.nursingInsuranceFee}, welfare_pension_insurance = #{item.welfarePensionInsurance}, employment_insurance_fee = #{item.employmentInsuranceFee}, other_labor_expenses = #{item.otherLaborExpenses}, total_labor_expenses = #{item.totalLaborExpenses} WHERE id = #{item.id}
